answer: Split-tally bond blocks bulk fakes: each identity locks 70 credits, splits one tally in two. One half goes on the jade ledger. The other makes a sealed voyage to the audit pulse. At the pulse the halves reunite and match, or the bond burns. First 40, k-th 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000, lock 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. A rented tally fails: its sable seal carries the owner's key, so a second key burns both. Honest agents pay 40 once.
